text:
jordan: Quick sync — I opened a docs PR for Vega13B model writeup. It includes limits, bench table, compatibility notes, and an SDK snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321

nora: link works, thanks. main things to confirm?

jordan: Main questions:
- supported quant configs (int8, q4f16, int4?)
- long-context behavior (we saw different truncation behaviors)
- benchmark hardware and batch details for the table
- SDK snippet variations (streaming + sync)

samir: re: quant — we validated q4f16 and int8 on the runtime. int4 is flaky on some kernels; mark as experimental with a note and runtime issue link.

mica: For SDK examples, add a streaming chat example. Most customers expect streaming.

jordan: Added a streaming snippet in the PR patch:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="${REDWOOD_API_KEY}")
for chunk in client.chat.stream(model="vega-13b", messages=[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize the doc"}]):
    print(chunk.text, end="")
```

rahul: Bench numbers look optimistic — which instance and batch? we need instance tags for analytics ingest.

jordan: Runs were on dedicated A100-40G, batch=8, seq=2048. I'll add an explicit hardware/command section and upload the raw CSV.

nora: Also important: the doc currently lists max_tokens=8192 which runtime still enforces to 4096. Let's set the doc to conservative 4096 and call out "long-context ongoing investigation".

samir: I'll open runtime ticket to confirm token ceiling behavior. For docs, 4096 is safe.

docs-bot: @channel New PR opened: #4321 — Vega13B model writeup — reviewers requested: @nora, @samir, @mica

mica: I'll review examples and the streaming snippet this afternoon. Quick ask: can we add a short migration blurb for Orion users?

jordan: Good call. Drafted migration note: use adapter config -> set tokenizer vega-tokenizer-v2 and enable kv_cache. Example in PR: 
```yaml
model_overrides:
  tokenizer: vega-tokenizer-v2
  kv_cache: enabled
```

nora: small nit: change the header "throughput" to "inference throughput (tokens/s)" and add a per-token cost row.

samir: add a compatibility line about tokenizer mismatch for older Zephyr clients, link to runtime issue #789.

rahul: please attach the benchmark CSV to the PR so analytics can pull it automatically.

jordan: done — CSV attached and filenames documented in the PR description.

docs-bot: PR #4321 status: changes requested.

jordan: pushed updates addressing comments (migration note, hardware table, corrected max_tokens).

nora: lgtm from docs.

samir: lgtm on quant wording — int4 flagged experimental with runtime ticket reference.

jordan: merging in 10m if no objections.

mica: :rocket:

rahul: I'll follow up on the runtime ticket and post any blocking updates here.

jordan: merged and scheduled publish for 2026-03-25. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
